    • DST_USAGE_NONE

      public static final int DST_USAGE_NONE
      The final blender combining paint color does not depend on dst.

    • DST_USAGE_DEPENDS_ON_DST

      public static final int DST_USAGE_DEPENDS_ON_DST
      The final blender depends on dst or pipeline has clip shader. This does not take into account the coverage of the renderer, as it may be coverage anti-aliasing (analytic XX) or masking (raster text, coverage mask).
      See Also:
